date-time.name: Date & Time Tools
date-time.description: Fast and accurate date, time, hours, week number, timestamp and time zone calculators.
date-time.seoDescription: Count days between dates, total work hours, find ISO week numbers, and convert Unix timestamps and time zones with exact, private calendar math.
date-time.intro: Calendar and clock math involves unexpected complexities like variable month lengths, leap years, overnight shifts, ISO week rules, daylight saving changes and epoch timestamps. Our Date & Time tools eliminate the guesswork by calculating exact durations, working hours, week numbers and time zone conversions directly in your browser.

howToChoose.title: To measure the gap between two dates
howToChoose.description: Use the Date Difference Calculator to view total calendar days, elapsed months, and working business days (Monday through Friday).

howToChoose.title: To find a past or future date
howToChoose.description: Use the Add or Subtract Days Calculator to shift forward or backward by calendar days or business days.

howToChoose.title: To track an upcoming event
howToChoose.description: Use the Days Until Date Calculator for real-time countdowns to birthdays, holidays, or deadlines.

howToChoose.title: To verify personal milestones
howToChoose.description: Use the Age Calculator to break down chronological age into years, months, days, and total lived hours.

howToChoose.title: To total hours worked or a weekly timesheet
howToChoose.description: Use the Hours Calculator for shift durations with breaks and overnight shifts, decimal hours, and weekly pay with overtime.

howToChoose.title: To find the week number of a date
howToChoose.description: Use the Week Number Calculator for today's ISO 8601 week, the week of any date, and the Monday-to-Sunday dates of any week.

howToChoose.title: To read or create a Unix timestamp
howToChoose.description: Use the Unix Timestamp Converter to turn epoch seconds or milliseconds into UTC and local dates, and dates back into timestamps.

howToChoose.title: To schedule across time zones
howToChoose.description: Use the Time Zone Converter & Meeting Planner to convert a time between cities with daylight saving applied and find shared working hours.

faqs.question: Do these calculators account for leap years?
faqs.answer: Yes. All our date calculators use standard astronomical calendar algorithms that account for 366-day leap years, February 29th boundaries, and century rules.

faqs.question: How are business days calculated?
faqs.answer: Business day calculations automatically exclude Saturdays and Sundays. Holidays can be accounted for by subtracting statutory dates from the total working day result.

faqs.question: How is daylight saving time handled in the time zone converter?
faqs.answer: The Time Zone Converter uses the IANA time zone data built into your browser, so the offset for each city is looked up for the exact date and time, including daylight saving changes.

faqs.question: Which week numbering does the week number calculator use?
faqs.answer: ISO 8601: weeks start on Monday and week 1 contains the year's first Thursday. The US-style number (weeks starting Sunday) is shown separately and clearly labelled.

faqs.question: Are my birthdates or dates saved?
faqs.answer: No. All date calculations run purely client-side in your web browser. We never log or store any date inputs.

education.name: Student & Exam Tools
education.description: Free grade, GPA, CGPA, marks, attendance, weighted average and merit aggregate calculators for students.
education.seoDescription: Calculate course grades, GPA, CGPA to percentage, marks percentages, attendance, weighted averages and admission merit aggregates with clear formulas.
education.intro: Report cards, transcripts, attendance registers and admission forms all ask for numbers in slightly different forms: a weighted course grade, a GPA on a 4.0 scale, a CGPA converted to a percentage, an attendance percentage, or a merit aggregate built from board marks and an entry test. Our Student & Exam tools show each calculation step by step, so you can check your result against your own result card and understand exactly where every number comes from, privately in your browser.

howToChoose.title: To calculate course grades and target exam scores
howToChoose.description: Use the Grade Calculator to compute current weighted course grades and determine the exact score needed on your final exam to hit your target grade.

howToChoose.title: To compute semester and cumulative GPAs
howToChoose.description: Use the GPA Calculator for high school and university GPAs on a 4.0 scale with plus/minus toggles, credit weighting, and multi-semester tracking.

howToChoose.title: To convert CGPA to a percentage, or a percentage to CGPA
howToChoose.description: Use the CGPA to Percentage Calculator with a 4.0, 5.0, or 10.0 scale, the simple proportion method, CBSE's 9.5 multiplier, or the conversion formula printed on your own transcript.

howToChoose.title: To find your percentage from exam marks
howToChoose.description: Use the Marks Percentage Calculator to turn obtained and total marks into a percentage, either as one total or subject by subject, with a typical BISE grade for reference.

howToChoose.title: To check attendance and plan absences
howToChoose.description: Use the Attendance Calculator to see your attendance percentage, how many classes you must attend to reach 75%, or how many you can miss and stay on target.

howToChoose.title: To average scores that count differently
howToChoose.description: Use the Weighted Average Calculator with percentage or plain-number weights to combine assessments, credits or categories, with each row's contribution shown.

howToChoose.title: To estimate an admission merit or aggregate
howToChoose.description: Use the Merit & Aggregate Calculator to combine Matric, Intermediate, entry test and interview marks with your own weights or verified NUST and MDCAT weights, then confirm them in the official prospectus.

faqs.question: How does the GPA calculator handle plus and minus grades?
faqs.answer: The GPA calculator includes an optional plus/minus toggle. When enabled, it applies standard university weights (e.g., A = 4.0, A- = 3.7, B+ = 3.3). When disabled, standard whole letter grades (A = 4.0, B = 3.0, C = 2.0, D = 1.0, F = 0.0) are used.

faqs.question: Is there one official formula to convert CGPA to percentage?
faqs.answer: No. Universities and boards use different conversions, and in Pakistan HEC does not publish one formula for every university. The official conversion is the one printed on your transcript or provided by your university's examination department, which you can enter in the CGPA to Percentage Calculator.

faqs.question: Which grading scale does the marks percentage calculator use?
faqs.answer: It shows the typical Pakistani board (BISE) grades for reference: A+ for 80% and above down to F below 33%. Boards can differ, so your board's result card is the final authority on your grade.

faqs.question: How many classes can I miss and still have 75% attendance?
faqs.answer: It depends on how many you have attended so far. The Attendance Calculator works it out exactly: with 45 of 50 classes attended you can miss 10 more and still have 75%.

faqs.question: Are the university merit formulas official?
faqs.answer: The merit calculator only includes presets checked against an official source, and shows that source and the date it was checked. Formulas can change each year, so always confirm the weights in the current prospectus; the admitting institution's own calculation is final.

faqs.question: Are my marks, grades, or GPA saved anywhere?
faqs.answer: No. All calculations run in your browser. Your marks, grades, and GPA are never sent to our servers or stored in any database.

math-finance.name: Math & Finance Tools
math-finance.description: Free loan EMI, compound interest, SIP, salary tax, salary to hourly, tip, profit margin, sales tax, gold, percentage, fraction, statistics and unit conversion calculators.
math-finance.seoDescription: Calculate loan EMIs, compound interest, SIP returns, tips, hourly pay, profit margins, tax, percentages, fractions and statistics with verified formulas.
math-finance.intro: Everyday math, personal finance, and measurement conversions require rapid, verified arithmetic. Whether computing monthly loan schedules, projecting compound interest, splitting a restaurant bill, converting a salary to an hourly rate, pricing with the right margin, working through fractions or summarising a list of numbers, our calculators deliver instant, private results directly in your browser.

howToChoose.title: To calculate loan and mortgage repayments
howToChoose.description: Use the Loan EMI Calculator to determine monthly installments, total interest, full amortization schedules, and payoffs with extra monthly payments.

howToChoose.title: To forecast long-term compound growth
howToChoose.description: Use the Compound Interest Calculator to project savings growth across daily, monthly, quarterly, or annual compounding with optional regular contributions.

howToChoose.title: To estimate mutual fund SIP wealth accumulation
howToChoose.description: Use the SIP Calculator to project future maturity values and total wealth gain with optional annual step-up contribution increases.

howToChoose.title: To solve direct, proportion, or reverse percentages
howToChoose.description: Use the Percentage Calculator to find X% of Y, determine what percentage X is of Y, increase or decrease by X%, or recover the original base value.

howToChoose.title: To evaluate sales markdowns
howToChoose.description: Use the Discount Calculator to compute final prices with single or stacked discounts and optional sales tax.

howToChoose.title: To convert measurements between metric and imperial
howToChoose.description: Use the Unit Converter for instant two-way conversions across length, weight, temperature, area, volume, and speed with exact conversion factors.

howToChoose.title: To estimate income tax on a salary in Pakistan
howToChoose.description: Use the Pakistan Salary Tax Calculator to see your monthly tax, take-home pay and FBR slab for tax year 2026-27, compared with 2025-26.

howToChoose.title: To price gold by tola, gram and karat
howToChoose.description: Use the Gold Calculator with today's rate from your sarafa association or jeweller to price 24K, 22K, 21K or 18K gold by tola, gram, masha or ratti, with making charges.

howToChoose.title: To add or remove GST and sales tax
howToChoose.description: Use the GST & Sales Tax Calculator to add tax to a price or find the price before tax inside a tax-inclusive total, at any rate.

howToChoose.title: To split a bill and work out the tip
howToChoose.description: Use the Tip Calculator & Bill Splitter for the tip, the total and each person's share, with tipping on the pre-tax amount and rounding up.

howToChoose.title: To compare a salary with an hourly rate
howToChoose.description: Use the Salary to Hourly Calculator to convert between annual, monthly, bi-weekly, weekly, daily and hourly pay with your hours and unpaid time off.

howToChoose.title: To set prices with the right margin
howToChoose.description: Use the Profit Margin & Markup Calculator to find margin and markup from cost and price, or the price that gives a target margin.

howToChoose.title: To add, subtract, multiply or divide fractions
howToChoose.description: Use the Fraction Calculator for fractions and mixed numbers with step-by-step working, simplifying and decimal to fraction conversion.

howToChoose.title: To summarise a list of numbers
howToChoose.description: Use the Mean, Median, Mode & Standard Deviation Calculator for averages, spread, quartiles and the working for each step.

faqs.question: How are financial figures and fractional numbers rounded?
faqs.answer: Financial calculations use standard half-up arithmetic rounding to the nearest cent ($0.01), preventing floating-point discrepancies and matching banking standards. Unit conversions use up to 6 decimal places of precision.

faqs.question: Are the investment returns in the SIP and Compound Interest calculators guaranteed?
faqs.answer: No. Investment projections are mathematical illustrations based on the expected annual return rate you enter. Market investments and mutual funds carry market risk, and actual returns will fluctuate over time.

faqs.question: How does an extra monthly payment reduce total loan cost?
faqs.answer: Any extra monthly payment goes directly toward reducing the principal balance. Because subsequent monthly interest is computed on the remaining principal, smaller principal balances accumulate less interest each month, significantly shortening the loan tenure.

faqs.question: What reference standards are used for unit conversions?
faqs.answer: All conversion factors adhere strictly to NIST (National Institute of Standards and Technology) and BIPM SI standards, using exact international definitions such as 1 inch = 0.0254 meters and 1 pound = 0.45359237 kilograms.

faqs.question: What is the difference between profit margin and markup?
faqs.answer: Both use the same profit, price minus cost. Margin divides it by the selling price and markup divides it by the cost, so cost 60 and price 100 is a 40% margin but a 66.67% markup.

faqs.question: Are my financial inputs or calculations saved?
faqs.answer: Never. All calculations run 100% client-side inside your local web browser. No loan amounts, income, or investment figures are ever sent to our servers or stored in any database.

text.name: Text & Writing Tools
text.description: Fast, private text utilities: counters, case converters, formatters, encoders, text comparison, duplicate removal and slug generation.
text.seoDescription: Count words, convert case, format JSON, encode Base64 and URLs, compare two texts, remove duplicate lines and create URL slugs, all client-side.
text.intro: Writing, data cleaning, and text encoding demand speed, precision, and privacy. Our text utilities help developers, writers, and students format JSON payloads, encode Base64 or URLs, compare two versions of a document, clean up lists, create SEO-friendly slugs, generate placeholder text, and audit text metrics locally in the browser.

howToChoose.title: To inspect text metrics
howToChoose.description: Use the Word & Character Counter to audit words, characters (with and without spaces), sentences, paragraphs, and estimated reading time.

howToChoose.title: To reformat capitalization
howToChoose.description: Use the Text Case Converter to quickly toggle between Title Case, Sentence case, UPPERCASE, lowercase, camelCase, snake_case, or kebab-case.

howToChoose.title: To prettify, validate, or minify JSON
howToChoose.description: Use the JSON Formatter & Validator to format with custom indentation, sort object keys, minify payloads, and locate syntax errors.

howToChoose.title: To convert text to Base64
howToChoose.description: Use the Base64 Encoder & Decoder for UTF-8 safe text conversion and standard or URL-safe Base64 encoding.

howToChoose.title: To encode URL parameters or addresses
howToChoose.description: Use the URL Encoder & Decoder to switch between component and full URI modes and parse query string parameters into tables.

howToChoose.title: To generate placeholder text
howToChoose.description: Use the Lorem Ipsum Generator to produce customizable dummy paragraphs, sentences, or word counts for design mockups.

howToChoose.title: To compare two versions of a text
howToChoose.description: Use the Text Diff Checker to see added, removed and changed lines with word-level highlights, side by side or inline.

howToChoose.title: To clean up a list
howToChoose.description: Use the Remove Duplicate Lines tool to delete repeated lines while keeping the original order, ignoring case or spaces if you need to.

howToChoose.title: To turn a title into a URL
howToChoose.description: Use the URL Slug Generator for lowercase, hyphenated slugs with accents removed, optional stop-word removal and bulk mode.

faqs.question: Is my text uploaded or stored?
faqs.answer: No. Text is analyzed and transformed entirely in memory on your device. We cannot view, log, or transmit any drafted text or payloads.

faqs.question: Can I compare large documents with the text diff checker?
faqs.answer: Yes. The comparison runs in a background thread in your browser, so documents with thousands of lines can be compared without freezing the page or uploading anything.

faqs.question: Is Base64 considered encryption?
faqs.answer: No. Base64 is an encoding format designed to transmit binary data over text-only protocols. It provides zero confidentiality and can be trivially decoded by anyone.

faqs.question: What is the difference between encodeURIComponent and encodeURI?
faqs.answer: encodeURIComponent encodes all delimiter characters (like &, =, ?, and /) for safe inclusion as query values, while encodeURI preserves valid URL structure characters.

faqs.question: Does the word counter support international text?
faqs.answer: Yes, word boundaries and characters are recognized across multilingual text, symbols, and accented characters.

security.name: Security & Privacy Tools
security.description: Client-side password generator and strength checker, JWT decoder, UUID v4 generator, and cryptographic hash tools.
security.seoDescription: Generate strong passwords, check password strength, decode JWTs, create UUID v4 identifiers and compute SHA-256 hashes locally with zero server storage.
security.intro: Online account protection, data integrity, and unique entity identification begin with cryptographically secure generation and careful inspection. Our security tools generate strong passwords and check how guessable a password is, decode JSON Web Tokens, create RFC 4122 UUID v4 identifiers, and compute cryptographic hashes locally in your browser, keeping your data entirely in your own hands.

howToChoose.title: To create resilient credentials
howToChoose.description: Use the Strong Password Generator with custom lengths (up to 64 characters), character set toggles, and ambiguous character exclusions.

howToChoose.title: To generate unique identifiers and GUIDs
howToChoose.description: Use the UUID / GUID Generator for RFC 4122 version 4 identifiers with bulk generation up to 100, custom casing, hyphens, and text export.

howToChoose.title: To compute cryptographic checksums or verify integrity
howToChoose.description: Use the Cryptographic Hash Generator to calculate SHA-256, SHA-512, SHA-384, or SHA-1 hashes and compare checksum matches live.

howToChoose.title: To check how strong a password is
howToChoose.description: Use the Password Strength Checker for a 0 to 4 score, estimated crack times and specific tips, computed offline on your device.

howToChoose.title: To read or check a JSON Web Token
howToChoose.description: Use the JWT Decoder to see a token's header, claims and expiry, and verify HS256, HS384 or HS512 signatures locally. Decoding alone does not prove a token is genuine.

faqs.question: How are passwords and UUIDs generated securely?
faqs.answer: We utilize the Web Cryptography API (crypto.getRandomValues and crypto.randomUUID) rather than pseudo-random functions, ensuring true hardware-backed entropy from your operating system.

faqs.question: Are generated passwords, UUIDs, or text hashes saved on your servers?
faqs.answer: Never. All generation and hash computations run 100% client-side in browser memory. The moment you close the tab, all inputs and outputs are wiped.

faqs.question: Why does the hash generator not support MD5?
faqs.answer: MD5 is cryptographically broken and vulnerable to practical collision attacks. To promote security best practices, we only provide collision-resistant SHA-2 algorithms and warn against using SHA-1 for passwords.

faqs.question: What is the recommended password length?
faqs.answer: Length matters more than complexity. NIST SP 800-63B-4 asks services to require at least 15 characters for a password used on its own and not to force mixtures of character types. A long random password or a passphrase of several unrelated words is strong; check it with the Password Strength Checker.

faqs.question: Is it safe to paste a JWT or password into these tools?
faqs.answer: The JWT Decoder and Password Strength Checker run entirely in your browser and never send, store or put your input in the page address. Even so, prefer test or expired tokens and avoid pasting live production secrets into any website.

fun.name: Fun & Random Tools
fun.description: Interactive random name pickers, random number generators, coin flips and dice rollers.
fun.seoDescription: Pick fair random winners, generate random numbers in any range, flip coins and roll dice with secure randomness for fair everyday decisions and games.
fun.intro: Choosing fairly shouldn't be difficult. Whether running a classroom giveaway, organizing a raffle, settling a decision with a coin toss, or rolling dice for a board game, our decision tools provide unbiased randomized results using your browser's secure random number generator.

howToChoose.title: To draw names or choices fairly
howToChoose.description: Use the Random Name Picker Wheel to enter a list of candidates and spin an interactive wheel with sound and confetti.

howToChoose.title: To pick random numbers
howToChoose.description: Use the Random Number Generator for one or up to 1,000 numbers in any range, with or without duplicates, sorted, or with decimals.

howToChoose.title: To flip a coin or roll dice
howToChoose.description: Use the Coin Flip & Dice Roller to flip up to 100 coins or roll up to 10 dice from d4 to d20, with totals and a history of results.

faqs.question: Is the random selection truly unbiased?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our random tools use the browser's cryptographically secure generator with rejection sampling, so every entry, number or face has an exactly equal probability.

faqs.question: Can I remove winners after each draw?
faqs.answer: Yes. The picker includes an optional toggle to eliminate selected names so each candidate can only win once.

faqs.question: How many names can I enter?
faqs.answer: You can paste dozens or hundreds of names simultaneously with instant line-by-line parsing.

faqs.question: Can I generate random numbers without repeats?
faqs.answer: Yes. Turn off duplicates in the Random Number Generator and every number drawn will be different, as long as the range contains enough values.

code.name: Code Formatters
code.description: Free, private code formatters for Python, Java and HTML that run entirely in your browser.
code.seoDescription: Format Python with the Ruff formatter and Java and HTML with Prettier in your browser. Your code is never uploaded; the engines are served from this site.
code.intro: Consistent formatting makes code easier to read, review, and diff. Our code formatters run well-known open-source engines directly in your browser: Ruff for Python, and Prettier for Java and HTML, including the CSS and JavaScript inside HTML pages. Paste a snippet, choose your line length and indentation, and get the formatted result instantly, with syntax errors reported by line and column. Your code never leaves your device.

howToChoose.title: To format Python code in Black-compatible style
howToChoose.description: Use the Python Formatter, which runs the Ruff formatter with 88-column lines and double quotes by default, or 79 columns for strict PEP 8.

howToChoose.title: To format Java classes and methods
howToChoose.description: Use the Java Formatter, which runs Prettier with prettier-plugin-java, with 4-space indentation by default and an option for Google-style 2 spaces.

howToChoose.title: To beautify or minify HTML
howToChoose.description: Use the HTML Formatter, which runs Prettier's HTML printer with 2-space, 4-space or tab indentation, formats inline CSS and JavaScript, reports unclosed tags, and has a careful minify mode.

faqs.question: Is my code uploaded when I format it?
faqs.answer: No. The formatting engines are downloaded from this site the first time you use a formatter and then run inside your browser. Your code is never sent to a server.

faqs.question: Which style do the formatters follow?
faqs.answer: The Python Formatter uses the Ruff formatter, which produces Black-compatible style. The Java and HTML Formatters use Prettier, with prettier-plugin-java for Java. You can change line length and indentation on each page.

faqs.question: Why does the formatter report a syntax error instead of fixing my code?
faqs.answer: A formatter only rearranges valid code. If a bracket, colon, semicolon, tag or indentation is wrong, the code cannot be parsed, so the formatter reports the line and column where parsing failed for you to fix first.
